rows: Real-data report only: Adult, Census KDD, Covertype, MNIST12, MNIST28, News, California Housing. RF/XGB/DNN labelers. Seeds 42/43. Credit, Intrusion, NB, PCA/GMM and simulations excluded.
synthetic and mix are separate analyses; analysis identifies the table origin and never enters a model as a factor. Combined real_data report contains these same two analyses.
100000 synthetic rows only; real-only reference rows are trained on real rows only.
All real training rows plus all 100000 synthetic rows, not a fixed 50/50 mixture; real-only reference rows are trained on real rows only.
Use task='classification' and row_role='relabeled'. All 120 cells observed. Exclude generated_target_baseline and real_only_reference from the factorial fit.

Join a relabeled row to exactly one generated-target baseline by dataset, seed and generator within its input CSV. This baseline is reused as a comparator, not counted as independent duplicated observations.

Average seeds and generators equally within each dataset. Relabeled mean also averages has_y and the three labelers equally. For has_y-specific means, average only the selected has_y level. Then subtract and average the five dataset differences equally. See contrast_weights.csv.
delta vector has five dataset differences. sd=SD(delta, ddof=1); se=sd/sqrt(5); t=mean(delta)/se; df=4; p=2*t.sf(abs(t),4); 95% CI=mean(delta) +/- t.ppf(.975,4)*se; cohen_dz=mean(delta)/sd.

For each generator/has_y/labeler cell, average the two seeds within each dataset; subtract the same-generator generated-target mean averaged over those seeds. Apply paired inference to the resulting five differences.
Enumerate all 32 sign assignments of five delta values. Two-sided p=mean(abs(mean(sign*delta)) >= abs(mean(delta))-1e-12). Minimum possible p is .0625.
Supplementary only: scipy.stats.wilcoxon(delta, method='approx', zero_method='wilcox'), two-sided; p=1 when all abs(delta)<1e-12.
Wins: delta>1e-10. Losses: delta<-1e-10. Ties: abs(delta)<=1e-10.
100 * (first mean - second mean) / second mean. For labeler comparisons second mean is its matched generated-target mean. Percentage points = 100 * macro-F1 change.

Within each analysis separately: three factorial marginal contrasts, four planned paired-t contrasts, four planned exact-sign-flip contrasts, and twelve labeler paired-t comparisons are separate Holm families. ANOVA and nested-model p values are nominal.
Sort m raw p values ascending. adjusted_sorted[i]=min(1,max over j<=i of ((m-j+1)*p_sorted[j])), using 1-based ranks. Restore the original row order.

Average primary-model prediction design rows equally over all five datasets and two seeds for each generator/has_y/labeler cell. Means equal raw cell averages on this balanced grid. Model CI uses t critical value with 92 residual df and fitted OLS covariance.

Average primary-model predictions over every observed combination of the other factors; contrast TVAE-CTGAN, has_y1-has_y0, seed43-seed42. Use fitted OLS contrast covariance and t with 92 residual df.
Type II ANOVA, sum-to-zero categorical coding. partial_eta_sq=term sum_sq/(term sum_sq+model residual sum_sq). Leave residual F/p/partial_eta_sq blank.

Compare seed_block with factorial (11 added df), and seed_block with dataset_interaction (20 added df). F=((SSE_restricted-SSE_full)/df_added)/(SSE_full/df_resid_full). Use F.sf with df_added and full-model residual df.

R_squared=1-SSE/SST; adjusted_R_squared=1-(1-R_squared)*(n-1)/df_resid. Shapiro p=scipy.stats.shapiro(fitted residuals). Residual and QQ plots are reproducible from each model specification and its input rows.

For each task and metric separately: original averages 2 seeds; generated averages 2 generators x 2 seeds; each has_y level averages 2 generators x 3 labelers x 2 seeds. Do not pool regression with classification or the two regression tasks.

R2 and D2: higher is better. NMAE: lower is better. NMAE=mae/saved sigma_y, using original-scale real test targets, population SD ddof=0. D2=1-d2_prediction_mae/saved baseline_mae; baseline_mae=mean(abs(y_test-saved median_y)). Read saved denominators; do not estimate them from these summary rows.

mae is the run record value used for NMAE. d2_prediction_mae is the verified saved-prediction value used by the D2 sidecar. Small serialization/precision differences can exist; use each metric with its own saved numerator.

*** p<.001; ** p<.01; * p<.05; . p<.10; otherwise blank. significant_05=1 exactly when the stated p_for_significance<.05 (bold in PDF). CSV cannot store bold formatting; these columns preserve its meaning.
95% confidence intervals are unadjusted even when the accompanying p value is Holm-adjusted.

ANOVA/model intervals assume independent homoskedastic errors and are exploratory. Seeds share held-out test rows; seed is categorical with two fixed levels. Paired inference uses five dataset means, not 120 independent tasks. Dataset interactions and nonnormal residuals limit pooled inference.
Repaired output heads; retained TVAE synthetic tables have documented held-out feature collisions. Preserve this caveat in replicated findings.

News uses log-target reruns scored in original units; Housing uses no-Faker reruns; Census KDD uses weighted macro-F1 development checkpoint selection; other datasets use development loss. Generator production settings: 500 epochs, batch 500, CUDA, 100000 synthetic rows. No experiment reruns were performed for this export.
Each input has 210 rows, including the same 14 real-only references. Union by record contains 406 runs. Do not count shared reference rows twice.
